decisions.reason: The dump truck line has not shown a clear shortfall, and the firm's slack allows it to carry the product while market acceptance develops.
The construction dumper fits the firm's transport and construction competencies, with no evidence of performance below aspiration, so it is kept.
The furniture lift line is a niche extension of lifting know-how, and given organizational slack and uncertain results, management keeps it to learn.
The building material lift serves existing construction customers and shows no clear shortfall, supporting a keep decision.
The truck-mounted version is more specialized and uncertain, but slack permits keeping it while evaluating its contribution.
